title: Your systems
as they are.
lead: Placement Desk connects to the systems your brokerage already uses, so the work moves without another system for your team to manage.

systems.title: Work goes in. Results come back.

items.title: Agency management systems
items.body: Reads client and policy data for the submission and writes activities, documents and results back. Connections are configured per deployment.

items.title: Document repositories
items.body: Pulls applications, loss runs, schedules and correspondence from where they already live.

items.title: Email and collaboration
items.body: Takes work from Outlook and Teams and returns results there, alongside the desk’s own inbox on your domain.

items.title: Data and reporting
items.body: Every action and outcome is available to your data lake or reporting tools, so desk performance can be measured alongside the rest of the business.

items.title: Carrier channels
items.body: Portals, APIs and underwriter email, worked by the desk directly. Covered in detail on the carrier channels page.

how.title: Read where you allow. Write where you expect.

steps.title: Map
steps.body: See what connects and where results should land.

steps.title: Connect
steps.body: Use scoped credentials for the systems the desk needs.

steps.title: Configure
steps.body: Set what it can read and write back.

cta.title: Tell us what you run.
cta.body: Show us your AMS, inboxes and document systems. We’ll map how Placement Desk would connect.
